C1.worst_defect: The home 'Before you start' list mixes what a counter needs (a browser, desktop Chrome, no cash drawer, no coupon codes) with server requirements a shop owner can't act on ('Node ^20.19 || >=22.12', Postgres, 'RXDB_PREMIUM'), so 'can my staff use this tomorrow?' is buried in developer detail.

C2.worst_defect: The site never says whether the till can run on the iPad or tablet a small shop is likely to have at the counter; the only line on devices is 'Its browser tests run in desktop Chrome', which leaves an owner guessing rather than reading a clear yes or no.

C3.worst_defect: The quick-start CORS step hides 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app' in a collapsed details block. That host name appears nowhere else and reads like a leftover, and step 2's 'say Tally, not VendurePOS' adds a second unexplained product name.

C4.worst_defect: At the till, the page staff would actually use, mixes plugin-version and live-demo caveats into the cashier steps. Item 1 of the 'Refund a sale' numbered list is not a step ('On plugin 0.3.0 the till cannot refund. Ask whoever manages your Vendure store to refund the order in the Vendure Dashboard...'), and it is followed by a separate 'Refund at the till (live demo)' section. Troubleshooting's counter guidance also asks staff to 'match its errorCode' from the sync log.

C5.worst_defect: The cashier-sheet screenshots disagree between devices: desktop shows 'open since 22:06' with no Sync now, while phone shows 22:07 with 'Last synced 10:07 PM / Sync now' and a grey stripe down the left edge. Neither shows the 'Closures' entry the text tells staff to find in the cashier sheet.

C6.worst_defect: At the till runs 9,213 px on a 390 px phone and has no short summary at the top, so a cashier checking 'how do I close the day' on a phone has to scroll past opening, selling, payment, receipts and refunds, with only the 'On this page' dropdown to jump.

C7.worst_defect: Small items only: Lighthouse mobile flags render-blocking resources and unused JavaScript, with LCP at 2.4 s on / and /docs/quick-start (perf 98). The 404 page's console error is the expected 404 resource load.

overall_worst.defect: The till guide I would hand my two staff, At the till, is a 9,213 px phone page that threads owner and version caveats ('On plugin 0.3.0...', 'On the live demo...') through the cashier steps. 'Refund a sale' opens with a numbered item that is a statement, not a step, so staff can't quickly see what to do at the counter for open, sell, refund and close.
overall_worst.where: at-the-till.desktop.02 / at-the-till.phone (Refund a sale, whole page)
overall_worst.fix: Put a five-line 'First shift' checklist at the top of At the till (open register with float → scan and sell → take card on your terminal, enter amount → print receipt → count drawer and close with Z report). Move the plugin-0.3.0 and live-demo notes into one callout, so the Refund steps start with what the cashier actually does.
